criteria.name: Customer-facing experience
criteria.description: Paid or substantial volunteer work serving customers directly: support, call or contact centre, retail, hospitality, front desk.

anchors.1: Brief or informal customer contact (a short placement, occasional volunteering) with few details.
anchors.2: At least one customer-facing role with stated duties, but short or low in detail (channels or volume not described).
anchors.3: Sustained customer-facing work in one or more roles, with clear duties and channels (phone, chat, email or in person).
anchors.4: Sustained, high-volume customer-facing work with specifics: channels, daily volume or queue size, and progression or added responsibility.

criteria.name: Problem solving and de-escalation
criteria.description: Resolving customer problems and calming difficult situations.

anchors.0: No evidence of resolving problems or handling difficult customers.
anchors.1: Generic claim only (e.g. 'good problem solver') with no example.
anchors.2: Mentions handling complaints, refunds or escalations, without an outcome.
anchors.3: Describes handling complaints or escalations with a concrete approach or outcome.
anchors.4: Repeated, specific examples of resolving complex or escalated cases, with measurable outcomes or recognition (e.g. reduced escalations, handled tier-2 cases).

criteria.name: Written communication
criteria.description: Writing to customers through email, chat or tickets, and writing help content.

anchors.1: Generic claim of good written skills only.
anchors.2: Mentions email, chat or ticket work without detail.
anchors.3: Clear evidence of regular written support (email or chat queues, ticket replies), or written help content.
anchors.4: Substantial written work with quality evidence: chat or email QA scores, knowledge-base articles or macros written, or training others on written tone.

nice_to_haves.name: Second language for support
nice_to_haves.description: Can support customers in a language other than English.

nice_to_haves.name: Support certification
nice_to_haves.description: A customer-support certification (e.g. HDI, a Zendesk or Salesforce admin badge).

nice_to_haves.name: Knowledge-base authoring
nice_to_haves.description: Has written help-centre articles or macros.
